key_insight: Effective Entropy measures diversity only among valid reasoning trajectories, separating useful exploration from incorrect-output noise.
engineering_relevance: VEPO offers a validity-aware exploration objective for training mathematical reasoning models with verifiable rewards.
method: Define entropy within the valid trajectory subspace.
Incorporate Effective Entropy into RLVR through Validity-aware Entropy Policy Optimization (VEPO).
Increase the probability of under-explored valid trajectories through an adaptive attraction dynamic.
evidence_signal: Across six math benchmarks with 1.5B and 7B DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models, VEPO improves aggregate accuracy over GRPO; matched-correct-count MATH500 evaluation finds more distinct strategies, supported by paired tests and three-seed comparisons.
watch_item: The validity-aware objective depends on reliable reward verification, and the abstract establishes results only for mathematical reasoning.
paper_title: The Illusion of Diversity: Aligning LLM Exploration via Effective Entropy
